articles.author: GlobeNewswire
articles.headline: Rubico Announces Its Decision to Exit the Megayacht Sector and Redeploy Capital towards its Core Tanker Business
articles.summary: Rubico announced an intention to sell its megayacht interest and redirect capital to tankers. The announcement describes a proposed divestment; it does not establish that a sale closed or cash was received.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire release explicitly July 15, 2026 05:00 ET, corroborated by an EDT syndication.

articles.author: GlobeNewswire
articles.headline: Rubico Announces Acquisition of Additional Newbuilding MR Tanker and a 33% Increase of Potential Gross Revenue Backlog to About $305 Million
articles.summary: Rubico announced an agreement to buy the company holding a tanker construction contract, with later vessel delivery and conditional closing. Its potential charter backlog is prospective revenue, not current earned revenue or completed vessel delivery.
articles.timestampEvidence: GlobeNewswire organization archive explicitly July 15, 2026 08:50 ET; Stockwatch reproduces the same timestamp and agreement terms.

articles.author: GlobeNewswire
articles.headline: Rubico Announces Management Estimate of Net Asset Value to $183.1 Million, a 94% Increase from the Previously Reported NAV
articles.summary: Rubico published management's estimated June 30 net asset value of $183.1 million, based on vessel valuations, debt and cash. This is an estimate with dilution assumptions; it is not verified cash proceeds or guaranteed realizable asset value.
articles.timestampEvidence: GlobeNewswire organization archive explicitly lists July 16, 2026 08:30 ET; Finviz and Stockwatch syndications agree.
